label: searchMovies.orama_hybrid_search
reason: Changed Orama search `limit` 1000→1020 increases the amount of work the search engine does (scoring/reranking + returning vectors) and can increase memory/time on the hot request path.
return_value_change: May return up to ~20 additional hits due to increased Orama `limit`, increasing downstream processing and possibly the size of the returned results array.

label: searchMovies.postprocess_candidates_and_levenshtein
reason: Work scales with `vectorResult.hits.length` (map hits→candidates, Levenshtein ordering, Map building, and filtering). Increasing `limit` increases CPU and memory pressure here and may dominate latency when many hits are returned.
return_value_change: May return a slightly larger ordered hit list because the candidate pool can be larger (due to increased search limit).
